properties.title: Francis McIntosh is lynched by a St. Louis mob
properties.description: A mob killed Francis McIntosh, a free Black steamboat cook, without a trial after his arrest following a fatal encounter with a deputy sheriff. The National Park Service places the lynching in the area now occupied by Kiener Plaza and notes that no one was punished.
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate public area at Kiener Plaza, identified by NPS; no exact tree or crime-scene address is asserted.

properties.title: Voters establish a tax-supported free library
properties.description: In 1893 St. Louis voters approved an independent, property-tax-supported library. The library moved that year into the Board of Education building at Ninth and Locust, replacing the subscription model with free service for city residents.
properties.placeName: Former Board of Education library building
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate public intersection beside the former library at Ninth and Locust; the building later became residences.
